verdict.rationale: Activepieces is open-source and explicitly supports self-hosting via Docker or a one-line installer, letting users run it 'on your own infrastructure' and 'keep the governance your company needs' — this gives de facto control over data location/region. However, there is no explicit cloud-offering region-selection feature or data-residency certification documented. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection controls for the managed/cloud service, compliance certifications (SOC2/GDPR data-locality guarantees), and documentation naming specific hosting regions.
